description: This file defines the NumberWidget class, a Drupal plugin for rendering number input fields with configurable settings such as placeholder, min, max, prefix, suffix, and step for decimal and float types.

classes.name: NumberWidget
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing a number input widget with configurable settings for number fields.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the widget, including an empty placeholder.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the settings form for the widget, allowing configuration of the placeholder text.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current widget settings, notably the placeholder.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Generates the form element for the number field, setting attributes like default value, placeholder, min, max, prefix, suffix, and step based on field type.

methods.name: errorElement
methods.description: Returns the form element to be used when validation errors occur.
